lines.en: My feet have not moved an inch.

lines.zh: 这一路上，只有灰落在我身上。
lines.en: Only dust has traveled over this body.
I don't walk; I stand where I am.
Wherever someone carries me, I go.

lines.zh: 我的位置从餐厅开张那天没变。
lines.en: My spot hasn't changed since the diner opened.

lines.zh: 一直被摆着，脚都陷进地板。
lines.en: Left standing so long, my feet have sunk in.

lines.zh: 我的影子随着灯动，人没动。
lines.en: My shadow moves with the lamp; I don't.

lines.zh: 我不需要走，人们会过来。
lines.en: I needn't walk; people come to me.

lines.zh: 我想迈一步，可关节不答应。
lines.en: I try to step, but my joints refuse.

lines.zh: 我的底座压着一块旧地毯。
lines.en: My base presses down an old rug.

lines.zh: 灰尘在我脚边积成一圈。
lines.en: Dust has banked into a ring at my feet.

lines.zh: 我一整天都在同一个格子里。
lines.en: All day I'm in the same square of floor.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，一直这么张着。
lines.en: My mouth hangs open, and stays open.

lines.zh: 我的紫色帽子歪了一点。
lines.en: My purple hat is slightly crooked.

lines.zh: 舞台的灯把我的影子打在墙上。
lines.en: The stage light throws my shadow on the wall.

lines.zh: 我身上的绒毛结了一层灰。
lines.en: A layer of dust has set into my fur.
My eyes have never blinked.

lines.zh: 肚子里的东西早就不转了。
lines.en: Whatever turned in my middle stopped long ago.

lines.zh: 我举着一只手，没放下过。
lines.en: One hand stays raised; it never comes down.
Tables are arranged in a ring around me.
I'm waiting for nothing.
The picture on the wall is older than I am.
The door opens and shuts; I don't move.
Dust has gathered in my mouth.
It's quieter here at night.
I listen to my own stillness.

lines.zh: 你看我很久了，我一直在看门口。
lines.en: You've watched me a while; I've been watching the door.

lines.zh: 我不是在瞪你，我只是不能眨眼。
lines.en: I'm not glaring; I simply can't blink.
Sit down? The tables are still here.

lines.zh: 你不该一个人来这种地方。
lines.en: You shouldn't come to a place like this alone.
Did this face of mine startle you?

lines.zh: 我身上有糖浆的味道吗。
lines.en: Do I still smell of syrup?
You stepped back, and I haven't moved.
I haven't spoken with anyone in a long while.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，客人以前站过。
lines.en: Someone used to stand right where you are.

lines.zh: 我的手举在这里很多年。
lines.en: My hand has been raised here for years.
If you touch me, will I come apart?
Don't be afraid; I won't lunge.
My voice gave out long ago.

lines.zh: 你的灯晃到我的眼睛了。
lines.en: Your light is shining into my eyes.

lines.zh: 这里只剩我一个在台上。
lines.en: I'm the only one left on stage.
It's dark back there. Will you look?

lines.zh: 我不催你，我哪儿也不去。
lines.en: I won't rush you; I'm not going anywhere.
Are you going to take me with you?
I rock once, then settle.
Dust spills out of my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的布裂了，里面是空的。
lines.en: My fabric split; it's hollow inside.
It doesn't hurt; I'm just crooked now.
My eyes dimmed for a moment.
I try to steady myself.
My hat has fallen off.
This shell won't hold much longer.
I'm still in that pose.

lines.zh: 你打的每一下我都数着。
lines.en: I'm counting every blow you land.

lines.zh: 我嘴里是空的，只有铁架。
lines.en: My mouth is empty but for the steel frame.

lines.zh: 你举食物给我看，有点可笑。
lines.en: Showing me food is a bit funny.
Even opening my mouth is a chore.
Leave it on the table.

lines.zh: 你带来的东西，你自己吃。
lines.en: Eat what you brought, yourself.
All I want is a customer.
Food goes off in this room.
Look, I haven't moved at all.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我连晃都没晃。
lines.en: You bump me and I don't even rock.
My feet are nailed to the floor.
You bounced yourself back a step.
Don't push; I'd topple.
I'm heavier than you'd think.

lines.zh: 你的手碰到了我的袖子。
lines.en: Your hand has touched my sleeve.
For a moment we're very close.
My fabric is coarse.
You move away and the dust settles back.
I'm the only one on this stage.
There's an empty chair beside me.
The others aren't here anymore.
We used to stand in a row.
My companions have all gathered dust.
Who was carried away, I don't know.

lines.zh: 台上的椅子空着，我对着它
lines.en: The chair on stage is empty; I face it anyway
I remember the hat that used to be beside me.
It broke before I did.
At night my shadow keeps me company.
I can't lower my hand.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我看得见却拿不到。
lines.en: I can see what fell, but can't reach it.

lines.zh: 我数过地上有多少碎片。
lines.en: I've counted every fragment on the floor.
My fingers can't hold anything.
There's a coin under the table.
Someone pick it up for me.

lines.zh: 东西在我脚边堆了很久。
lines.en: Things have piled at my feet for a long time.

lines.zh: 我把它们都记住了位置。
lines.en: I've memorized where each one lies.
I see it clearly; I just can't touch it.
Consider it my collection.
There's nothing for me to chase.
You moved, and I still can't.
My head faces the door.
Someone came in. I know.
Footsteps come down the hall.
All I can do is watch.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛跟着你的方向。
lines.en: My eyes follow where you go.
Strike if you like; I can't stop you.
I can hear you, but I can't follow.

lines.zh: 我的注意力停留在一处。
lines.en: My attention stays in one place.

lines.zh: 这屋里的东西都是我的。
lines.en: Everything in this room is mine.

lines.zh: 门是我唯一的注视方向。
lines.en: The door is the one thing I watch.
You've come up to the stage.

lines.zh: 我的关节锈了，可还在笑。
lines.en: My joints rusted, my smile stayed.
Don't think I'm waiting for you.
I watch you until you leave.

lines.zh: 你绕到后面，我的头转不过去。
lines.en: You step behind; my head won't turn.
I've stayed exactly here.
My gaze rests on you.

lines.zh: 你走远一点，我还是看得见。
lines.en: Move further off; I still see you.
If the light goes out, I can't see.
I don't push, and I don't move.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我脚边拉长。
lines.en: Your shadow stretches to my feet.
I know you're still in the room.

lines.zh: 地板响了一下，我听见了。
lines.en: The floor creaked; I heard it.
You've stopped outside the door.
I won't call you.
My line of sight won't pass the tables.

lines.zh: 这屋子里没有第二个出口。
lines.en: There's no second way out of this room.
I've watched so long my eyes feel dry.
One more step forward.

lines.zh: 我把脸固定在这个角度。
lines.en: My face is set at this angle.

lines.zh: 你看不见的时候，我还在看。
lines.en: When you can't see me, I'm still watching.

lines.zh: 我的手指只动了一点点。
lines.en: My fingers move only a little.
I didn't throw that.
I can't even close my teeth.

lines.zh: 如果你打我，我只能站着。
lines.en: If you hit me, I can only stand.
My arm is frozen in the air.
This isn't an attack; it's a pose.
I heard something crack.
That was you hitting a table.
I can only watch you back away.
I can't even dodge.
This shell won't protect me.

lines.zh: 你打在我身上，灰落了一层。
lines.en: You hit me and a layer of dust falls.
I haven't struck back at all.
My joint stuck again.
I'm still in this pose.
The light settles on me.

lines.zh: 桌上摆好了餐具，客人没来。
lines.en: The tables are set; the guests never came.
I turn my face to the door.
Again today, nobody came.
Only my shadow is left in the diner.

lines.zh: 我从开张那天就站在这里。
lines.en: I've stood here since opening day.
The hat is still that purple one.
Dust falls and I don't wipe it off.
This one tile of floor is mine.
My mouth hangs open, waiting to speak.
The door has opened a crack.
I turn my eyes toward it.
The lights here are never turned off.
A chair is askew and I can't right it.
I hear the wind outside again.
From this stage to the door is eleven steps.
I can't take a single one.

lines.zh: 火顺着绒毛爬，我拍不了。
lines.en: Fire creeps up my fur and I can't swat it.
I topple and knock a chair over.
Water soaks my cloth and I get heavier.
The blast lifts me off the floor.

lines.zh: 一颗子弹打掉了我一只耳朵。
lines.en: A bullet takes off one of my ears.

lines.zh: 光笼住我，我本来就动不了。
lines.en: Light cages me; I couldn't move anyway.
I've waited here for many years.

lines.zh: 雷照亮了整个餐厅，我的影子拉得很长。
lines.en: Lightning lights the whole diner and my shadow stretches long.
No floor beneath me; I'm adrift.
